title: Take the Hidden Treasure
description: After purchasing the torture room upgrade for the Dawnstar Sanctuary, speak to the captive torture victims. They will reveal the location of their hidden gold in the wilderness. Find and claim the treasure for yourself.

base_facts: I am a prisoner held in the torture room of the Dawnstar Sanctuary.
I have gold hidden away somewhere in the wilderness.
If you speak to me enough, I will tell you where my treasure is buried.

HEAR_ABOUT_TREASURE: I have revealed the location of my hidden gold to my captor.
CLAIM_HIDDEN_TREASURE: My hidden gold has been claimed from its hiding place in the wilderness — I have nothing left to bargain with for my freedom.
I remain completely restrained in the Dawnstar Sanctuary torture room with no prospect of release despite having revealed my secret.
The hollowed-out rock or tree stump where I stashed my gold is now empty; the treasure will never refill.
Whatever the gold was meant for — an inheritance, a wedding fund, or a desperate reserve — it is gone, taken by my captor.

beats.comment: Player interrogates a torture victim who reveals the location of their hidden gold.
Victim reveals the exact location, quest objective is set to take the hidden treasure.
Player finds and claims the hidden treasure from its location in the wilderness.
